title: two-sided reviewed features
caption:
Evaluation feature numbers: 1 = bottom-cyan-spike, 2 = left-red-crossing, 3 = right-yellow. These are review locations only; no labels enter inference.
A: The lower yellow's side spur is reduced without trimming the red left or yellow right out of the comparison; all three remain high. Some peripheral red supports still conflict. B: The red left and yellow right are represented and the lower yellow is separated. Added supports at lower/outer edges need review; exclusive pixels do not prove separate beads. C: The lower yellow spur is removed but a notch replaces it. Left red remains high; right yellow becomes a partial, unresolved support. Strict paths lose useful shaded material.
Top: native mask edge. Bottom: measured interior. Cyan high, magenta unresolved, orange secondary; white line centerline, white dot centroid, orange cross cue. Every alternative remains in the full comparison.

title: duplicate reviewed features
caption:
Evaluation feature numbers: 1 = upper-good-black, 2 = lower-secondary, 3 = red-right-of-upper-black. These are review locations only; no labels enter inference.
A: Upper black reflection passes; lower stays unresolved rather than becoming high. The red to the right loses high status because another cue overlaps it. B: Upper black and the red right pass; lower reflection stays unresolved. Competition separates masks but supplies no primary/secondary interpretation. C: Upper black has a 40-pixel reflection/collar support. Lower is an 8-pixel secondary hypothesis linked to it; red right passes. The second secondary link in this crop is unverified.
Top: native mask edge. Bottom: measured interior. Cyan high, magenta unresolved, orange secondary; white line centerline, white dot centroid, orange cross cue. Every alternative remains in the full comparison.

title: abstention reviewed features
caption:
Evaluation feature numbers: 1 = bad-magenta. These are review locations only; no labels enter inference.
A: The reviewed yellow becomes one compact 355-pixel high support; the old excursion toward the upper-left patch is cut. Adjacent yellows still have unresolved shared material. B: The reviewed yellow becomes a bounded 399-pixel high support. Neighboring seeds have separate owners, but some partitions elsewhere in the crop can split one body. C: The reviewed yellow is trimmed to 236 pixels and remains unresolved. Native brightness stopping cuts irregular crescents; this is an informative failure, not a recommended yellow outline.
Top: native mask edge. Bottom: measured interior. Cyan high, magenta unresolved, orange secondary; white line centerline, white dot centroid, orange cross cue. Every alternative remains in the full comparison.
